products.name: Custom House Portrait
products.size: Original 8×10 drawing, matted to fit an 11×14 frame
products.summary: An original pen and ink portrait of your home, with or without watercolor.
description: A hand-drawn portrait of a home: the closing gift clients actually keep, and a one-of-a-kind keepsake for anyone who loves their house.

✦ A gift for every home story
Closing gifts for clients • First homes • Housewarmings • A childhood home before it's sold • Anniversaries and holidays

✦ For realtors
Looking for a closing gift your clients will actually keep? A hand-drawn portrait of their new home is personal, memorable, and ready to hang the day they move in. I'm based in the Philadelphia area and love drawing the region's stone homes, rowhouses and twins.
- Tell me your closing date and I'll plan around it
- I can ship directly to your client with a handwritten gift note
- Ordering for several clients, or coming back for your next closing? Email me about repeat-client discounts

✦ Good to know
- Let me know about any details that matter to you, and I'll make your home look its best.
- If you decide not to continue after seeing the sketch, you owe nothing more. The deposit covers my time and materials.
- Want a larger size or more than one house? Email me for a custom quote.

Thank you for supporting an independent artist!
— Ed
details: An original 8×10 drawing: never a print, no AI, no digital tools
Pen and ink on cotton-blend watercolor paper, signed by me
Matted to fit a standard 11×14 frame, or matted and framed, ready to hang
I can ship directly to your client with a handwritten gift note
steps: Pay the 50% deposit here, then email me a clear, straight-on photo of the home (send a few if you have them).
I draw a pencil sketch and send you a photo. Small changes are included at this stage. If you decide not to continue, you owe nothing more.
Once you approve it, I ink the final piece, and add watercolor if you chose it.
I send you a photo of the finished portrait and an invoice for the other 50%. It ships free once that's paid.
products.policy: Turnaround is usually 2 to 4 weeks from sketch approval. The 50% deposit is non-refundable once I've started your sketch. Ordered by mistake? Email me within 2 days and, if I haven't started, I'll refund it in full. Want a larger size or more than one house? Email me for a custom quote.
